boundary: No runtime edits, source/criteria changes, SSH, native calls or run changes. All inspected file hashes match snapshot manifest.
Recorded running states are capture-time metadata only. No Drop correction artifact exists in this snapshot; its forthcoming scope choice cannot be assessed here.

This audit does not retroactively promote an artifact, override frozen obligations or clear review flags. Reported source support, graph scope necessity and experimental correctness are distinct judgments.
review_integrity: All three original review schemas, exact target coverage, canonical workflow/packet bindings and citation references pass existing validate_review against copied packets; this does not revalidate original remote files or establish claim entailment.

review_records.description: The independent ERCC efficiency estimate is selected in operation:count_umis resources (12.8%), but its calibration data path is incomplete. Add a separately identified control/analysis boundary linking the reported ERCC replacement feed (0.32% stock; PBS, RNase inhibitor and BSA; about 100,000 molecules/droplet) to joint ERCC/hg19 bait alignment, corrected substitution-only UMIs per ERCC species and the known-input/detected-count comparison. Preserve the >1 predicted molecule/droplet domain, slope-one log regression on the seven highest points giving 0.128 and the separate detected-total/input-total estimate 0.125. The current contextual prose and source quotes do not themselves represent those connected inputs, outputs and estimator. Keep this independent of native-cell production; no extra universal spike-in or correction factor is warranted.

The 10.7% independent ddPCR corroboration is explicitly included in operation:count_umis, but lacks its separate material/measurement/comparison dependencies. Represent bulk RNA from 50,000 HEK cells, RNeasy Plus purification and 1 cell-equivalent/microliter RT-ddPCR at the named supported boundary, Bio-Rad droplet generation/QX100/QuantaSoft readout, the ten-gene panel, three parallel preparations and two measurements per gene/preparation, and comparison with mean per-cell Drop-seq detected counts yielding the reported estimate. Preserve the external-control role rather than routing ddPCR material into the STAMP library. The frozen packet supports this repair; unavailable evidence is not the issue.

findings.reasoning: The draft explicitly calls 12.8% ERCC and 10.7% ddPCR independent validation, says ERCC replaces cells, and denies a per-cell correction factor or promised efficiency. Its native-cell matrix does not consume an ERCC-derived efficiency, ddPCR measurement or calibration coefficient. Those assays therefore support attributed performance conclusions, not a necessary production or decoding dependency. The reviewer follows source obligations whose condition includes merely reporting the estimate; that trigger can promote incidental contextual prose into an additional required graph endpoint.
findings.necessary_if: A user selects conversion-efficiency estimation itself, or a graph applies a calibration factor to its primary output; then known-standard input, measurement, correction rule and estimator dependencies must be represented at the supported level.
findings.not_necessary_for_general_method: Full ERCC feed/references/top-seven-point regression/alternative total ratio and full ddPCR ten-gene, three-preparation, twice-measured historical design need not become mandatory procedure branches merely to cite the authors performance estimates. Exact replication counts are historical execution detail unless that specific estimator precision/experiment is the declared endpoint.
findings.prospective_minimum: Keep validation conclusions and limits as explicitly source-attributed context outside the procedure, or omit optional numerical performance context. Do not infer that mentioning a measured performance number selects its full experimental workflow. This is not permission to clear the current frozen review gate or silently reinterpret its obligations.

review_records.description: operation:encapsulate_capture and state:expression_matrix preserve sparse occupancy and individual concentration values but omit the reported loading tradeoff needed to interpret nominal single-cell outputs. Add the source-qualified Poisson-limiting context and the concentration dependence of doublets/ambient impurity versus throughput. Retain final 12.5–100 cells/microliter as characterized modes, with about 1,200 versus 10,000 single-cell libraries/hour at the endpoints, rather than universal specimen input settings. The existing 50-final-cell and 120-feed/60-final-bead statements can remain; no new numerical species-calibration endpoint is required merely to state the tradeoff.

operation:recover_beads omits the reported timing condition: droplets were broken as soon as droplet generation was complete. Add prompt breakage to that operation/condition without inventing an incubation or a new routine-motion node. This is an available execution condition, not a missing architecture interface or a research blocker.

state:expression_matrix and operation:retain_cell_matrix omit source-reported expression-bias limits required for the readout interpretation. Retain the observed lower ascertainment of GC-rich transcripts and the comparison-specific transcript-length bias against standard mRNA-seq, with the qualification that the length bias was not observed against in-solution TSA and its proposed suppression-PCR cause was tentative. These are limitations on measured expression, not requirements to insert the comparison experiments into production.

source_refs.excerpt: As soon as droplet generation was complete, droplets were broken with perfluorooctanol in 30 mL of 6x SSC.

findings.reasoning: Prompt droplet breakage is a genuinely omitted reported production timing condition and can be added to recover_beads without a new node. Concentration-dependent occupancy/purity/throughput is a meaningful operating tradeoff, but endpoint throughput numbers describe characterized modes, not universal input settings. GC ascertainment and comparison-specific length bias qualify interpretation and belong on existing readout/context records; the reviewer itself does not require reconstructing those comparison experiments.

findings.unchanged: All flows, modules, unresolved gaps, gap resolutions and operation/state ID lists are unchanged.

findings.reasoning: Adding BioLegend attributes the already-selected panel. Interpreting the documented B+A key and numbered table identities as logical (B index,A index) makes an existing decoder interface explicit; the correction labels it inferred and retains the separate physical-orientation/missing-lookup gaps. This is not a request to reconstruct a historical study or add another scientific stage.
findings.limit: Correction evidence-reference integrity passed locally; the fresh reviewer was only recorded running at capture, so this does not assert final acceptance.

findings.exact_clause: Do not return the analytical amplification product to the sequencing library.
findings.source_entails: The whole library is amplified five cycles, an aliquot is withdrawn and given 10 uL cocktail/SYBR, that reaction is run 20 cycles to determine extra cycles for the remaining 45 uL production reaction.
findings.source_does_not_explicitly_report: The paragraph gives no explicit prohibition on returning aliquot product. It supports a distinct analytical branch and remaining production route, but the imperative is stronger than reporting that no recombination route is described.
findings.qualification: A no-return practice may be scientifically defensible inference. This is not evidence the aliquot was actually returned, should be returned, or that the represented separate production route is experimentally wrong. The target is reported-vs-inferred attribution and directive wording, not biological impossibility.
findings.prospective_minimum: Use source-faithful descriptive wording such as the source describes additional amplification of the remaining45uL and does not describe return of the analytical product; do not turn absent documentation into an explicit author prohibition.

prospective_scope_gate: Select an operation/control/calibration branch when its material, decision or estimator is required to perform or decode the declared assay endpoint, or when that additional endpoint is explicitly requested. Retain source-attributed validation findings and limitations as context without automatically expanding every supporting experiment into the procedure. Historical replicate counts, cohort design and performance fits are not required solely because their conclusions are cited.
